pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions (anti-martingale/no pyramiding into falling knives) until primary position achieves +$10.00 floating profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero execution within 15 minutes of Tier-1 macro news events; mandatory volume-weighted average price (VWAP) confirmation alongside a 3-bar volatility contraction index check.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop and partial profit locks as soon as open trade profit hits +$15.00, ensuring maximum capture up to +$30.00.
